title: Proposed West Maui critical access hospital
summary: A West Maui hospital resolution will return at the next council meeting after its sponsor asked to hold it, and members agreed with no objections. Earlier, on October 10, a commissioner said a West Maui medical facility was not ready for the commission to take up.
